correctness.rationale: Complex irreducibles of the extraspecial exponent-3 group have Q one-dimensional characters plus two dimension-d=3^n representations; regular-block multiplicities are d. The scalar cancellation 1+zeta^a+zeta^b yields line/nonline nullities; commuting isotropic independent differences give two joint zero eigenpairs with multiplicity d/9, and noncommuting Heisenberg Weyl pair yields (U+W)^3=2I hence invertible I+U+W. Symplectic quotient incidence gives nullities 2Q,2Q/3,2Q/9 and exact support counts Q(3Q-1)/2,3Q(Q-1)^2/2,3Q^2(Q-1), summing to binomial(3Q,3). Independently enumerated all 2925 order-27 triples and modular ranks, obtaining exactly (18:117,6:864,2:1944); higher-rank complex theorem rests on representation arguments rather than mod-1009 enumeration.
